tags: kwikset signature series smart code Lock

text.description_html:
Kwikset 955, SmartCode Electronic Pembroke Lever Lock

A Smart Code Electronic Lock means security without having to carry around keys. Customize up to 30 unique user codes for controlled access. Optional programming code allows for management of lock settings from the exterior keypad instead of the programming button in the interior. This Smart Code Lock is easy to install since it does not require wiring. Instead, it uses a 9V battery that will last up to 3 years. The Smart Code Lock is operated by keypad or key on the exterior and by a thumb turn on the inside. Available in 4 finishes.

The 955 SmartCode Electronic Pembroke Lever Lock uses Kwikset's Smart Key technology. Patented side locking bar design replaces traditional pin and tumbler design to prevent against lock bumping. The Smart Key lock cylinder is rekeyable by using the included learn tool in less than 30 seconds without removing the lock from the door.

Smart Code Lock is operated by a keypad or key on the exterior side, and by a thumb turn on the inside. Property managers can take advantage of three different locking modes for the most fitting application of this electronic lever for their properties.

Features Kwikset 955 SmartCode Electronic Pembroke Lever Lock:

  • ADA Compliant
  • ANSI/BHMI Grade 2
  • BHMA certified AAA - Highest residential security, durability and finish ratings
  • Keypad stays lit for 5 seconds after inactivity.
  • SmartKey Security™ re-key technology is compatible with Kwikset (KW1) keyway
  • Keyway features BumpGuard protection against lock bumping or picking.
  • Easy configure auto door locking feature for after 10, 20, 30, 40 or 50 seconds.
  • 30 code capacity.
  • Optional one-time access code for emergencies
  • Low battery warning.
  • No wiring means it is easy to install.
  • Easy to program.
  • Easily installs in minutes with just a screwdriver on a standard door (1 3/8" - 1 3/4" thick) and 2 1/8" cross bore hole

Specifications of the SmartCode Electronic Lock:

  • Assembled Height: 5-31/32"
  • Assembled Width: 5-3/4"
  • Assembled Length: 3-5/16"
  • Door Thickness: adjustable 1-3/8" to 2"
  • Backset: adjustable for both 2-3/8" or 2-3/4"
  • Reversible lever to fit right-hand and left-hand doors
  • Fits 2-1/8" Crossbore Hole (Standard Pre-Drilled Door)
  • Kwikset 955 Specifications (PDF)
  • Kwikset 955 Installation and Programming Guide (PDF)

    • Sold Individually
